messages.content: Give me a summary of this file.

[Source 1] The report, titled "EQUIPMENT INSPECTION REPORT" for GT-01, indicates a routine condition inspection conducted on 04 September 2026 by the Maintenance department. The equipment was observed to be running during the inspection, with a turbine temperature of 587°C and a vibration level of 8.2 mm/s. The visual inspection revealed abnormal vibration near the bearing housing, but no visible external damage was noted on the turbine enclosure. The inspector assessed that the temperature was above the critical threshold specified in the maintenance manual, and the vibration exceeded the inspection threshold, necessitating immediate maintenance attention. The recommended initial action includes initiating a controlled shutdown procedure, notifying the maintenance supervisor, and inspecting the bearing and rotor assembly after the equipment reaches a safe condition.
